subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: End Effectors: The Robot's Hand
description: A quick win: understand End Effectors: The Robot's Hand.

hook.text: A robot arm is useless without its end effector — the tool at the tip. Grippers, welders, drills, and sprayers all mount here.

buildup.text: Mechanical grippers use fingers driven by pneumatics or electric motors. They pinch, wrap, or clamp objects.

discovery.text: Vacuum grippers suck flat objects using suction cups. Magnetic grippers hold steel parts without squeezing.

twist.text: A quick-change adapter lets a robot swap end effectors in seconds. One arm handles multiple tasks in one cell.

climax.text: The end effector determines what the robot can do. The arm just positions it. The tool is the real star.

punchline.text: The arm reaches. The end effector acts. Choose the right tool.

quiz.question: What does a quick-change adapter allow a robot arm to do?
options: Switch between different tasks by swapping end effectors in seconds
Move faster by reducing the weight of the tool at the end
Connect to different power sources depending on the task
